title: MAIN THEME EPISODE 17: CRITICAL PHASE TRANSITION
lines: 01 MAIN THEME EPISODE 17: CRITICAL PHASE TRANSITION
OPEN TIME: October 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
EXTREME MODE OPEN TIME: October 21, 2026, 16:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 3-8

DETAILS: During the period from October 14, 08:00 to October 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7), the unlock requirement for Main Theme Episode 17: Critical Phase Transition will be temporarily lowered. By clearing Main Theme 3-8 , players can earn the 'Factory scrip' for a limited time by completing stages in the Critical Phase Transition. ('Factory scrip' can be used to redeem items in Unlicensed Clinic.)
Note:

◆ After October 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7), players need to clear Main Theme 16- 19 to unlock Critical Phase Transition, and the limited-time drop of 'Factory scrip' will end. During the event period, players' progress and First Clear Rewards obtained in Critical Phase Transition will not be reset.
◆ After the EP17 Critical Phase Transition unlocks, players can earn Simulation Points from Strategic Simulation for extra rewards (Originite Prime, Elite Materials) and unlock Extreme Mode.
[Joint Terminal]
DETAILS: Players can collect clues in the [Joint Terminal] to unlock rewards.
REWARDS: Viy's Token, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, and more.
[ List of Items Required ]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [List of Items Required] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★ ★ : Viy], Elite Materials, LMD, 'Factory scrip', etc.

From October 14, 2026, 08:00 to November 4, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7), players can obtain 'Factory scrip' by completing missions in [List of Items Required]. (Unclaimed 'Factory scrip' from limited-time missions completed before November 4, 2026, 03:59 can still be claimed until November 11, 2026, 03:59.)
[Unlicensed Clinic]
DURATION: October 14, 2026, 08:00 - November 4, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain 'Factory scrip' by clearing event stages and completing [List of Items Required]. 'Factory scrip' can be used to redeem items from [Unlicensed Clinic].

REWARDS: Emergency Sanity Sampler, Rhodes Island Supply Crate (contains Emergency Sanity Sampler*1 and Rhodes Island Supplies X*1), 'Bunny Cheer Audio-Video Room' Furniture (Pieces), Shining Steps Collection - Sing a Song for Pinecone, Bloodline of Combat Collection - Professional for Spot, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
02 LIMITED HEADHUNTING OPEN – SEALED WITH TIME
DURATION: October 14, 2026, 08:00 - October 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited Headhunting, [Sealed With Time], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Kal'tsit Esperanta [Limited] / Closure
★★★★★★: Exusiai the New Covenant [Limited] / Lappland the Decadenza [Limited] / Wiš'adel [Limited]
★★★★★: Crackborne

In this [Limited Headhunting], players will get the limited Operator Kal'tsit Esperanta after a total of 300 rolls (once only) . This special 6-star Operator is a bonus gift that does not give [Headhunting Data Contracts], and does not affect the chance to get the next 6-star Operator in this [Limited Headhunting]. This count is reset at the end of this [Limited Headhunting].
Note:
- [Sealed With Time] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] is Limited Headhunting.
- Closure and Crackborne will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after October 28, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).

- Operator Specter the Unchained will be available in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] during [Limited Headhunting - Celebration]. The required Headhunting Data Contracts for Specter the Unchained will be reduced from 300 to 200 starting this headhunting.
Available Operators from the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop]:
★★★★★★ (300 Headhunting Data Contract): Kal'tsit Esperanta / Closure / Exusiai the New Covenant / Lappland the Decadenza / Wiš'adel / Virtuosa / Muelsyse / Texas the Omertosa
★★★★★★ (200 Headhunting Data Contract): Specter the Unchained / Nearl the Radiant Knight / Skadi the Corrupting Heart / Rosmontis / W
★★★★★ (75 Headhunting Data Contract): Crackborne
- Kal'tsit Esperanta is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.

05 NOTICE BOARD IN ZELGRAD OPEN
DURATION: October 14, 2026, 08:00 - October 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Wishing Tickets each day upon login. Consume trials to select Wishing Tickets as permitted in [Notice Board in Zelgrad]. The Wishing Tickets with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
Note:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Wishing Tickets.
- Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Wishing Tickets:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.

UPDATE TIME: October 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the update, all players will receive a 30-point increase to max Sanity based on current level. Players will also receive an additional 30 Sanity after the update. The maximum Sanity limit after this adjustment will be 210.

DETAILS: After the update, the rewards in the Cumulative Sign-In system will be updated. Players who reach Level 80 and accumulate 1,500 sign-in days can obtain the Themed Background [Resolve].

Newcomer Special Headhunting Pack (Limited to 2 purchases)
DURATION: October 14, 2026, 08:00 - October 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
ELIGIBLE PLAYERS: Players who registered before October 14, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Players need to choose one option from the following when purchasing this headhunting pack:
Type-α Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Ascalon, Typhon, Ho'olheyak)
Type-β Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Lemuen, Nymph, Jessica the Liberated)
Type-γ Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Goldenglow, Reed the Flame Shadow, Gnosis)

Players will receive the chosen custom headhunting permit upon purchase. The selected permit can be used to perform a [Special Ten-roll Headhunting] that guarantees one random 6-star Operator from its pool.
[Special Ten-roll Headhunting]
- You may select only one of the Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permits and you can only purchase it twice. You cannot change your decision after purchasing.

- The permit is good for [Special Ten-roll Headhunting]. While performing any rolls in [Special Ten-roll Headhunting], rolls that do not give a 6-star Operator will not count towards the 6-star protection mechanism, nor will it affect your accumulated roll count on [Standard Headhunting]. Rates are also not affected by your accumulated roll count on [Standard Headhunting].

- For this Headhunting, players are guaranteed to receive a 6-star Operator when performing a 10-roll. The available pool of 6-star Operators is the same for every player, and depends on the [Special Ten-roll Headhunting] pool chosen.
- [Special Ten-roll Headhunting] includes 5★, 4★, and 3★ Operators from [600 Meters Over the Facts] and all previous [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting] banners.
NOTE:
- Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expires at: November 26, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- You may only use this Headhunting Permit once. Upon use, its Headhunting pool will automatically be removed.
- If not used by the expiration date, this Headhunting Permit will be removed from your Depot, so please make sure to use it before it expires.
Aside from a guaranteed 6-star Operator from the selected Headhunting Permit, the pull rates for the [Special Ten-roll Headhunting] are as follows:
★6 Operator: 2%
★5 Operator: 8%
★4 Operator: 50%
★3 Operator: 40%
